::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggokabeito)
data(penguins)
penguins <- penguins |> filter(!is.na(bill_len), !is.na(bill_dep), !is.na(body_mass))
```
:::


<!-- `##` starts a row, `###` a column. The heading text ("Row"/"Column") is only a label. -->
## Row {height="20%"}


::: {.cell content='valuebox' title='Species'}

```{.r .cell-code}
list(
  color = "primary",
  icon = "tags",
  value = n_distinct(penguins$species)
)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}


## Row {height="80%"}

### Column

<!-- Each code cell becomes a `.card`. Its `#| title:` sets the card header. -->


::: {.cell title='Body mass by species'}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(penguins, aes(species, body_mass, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_okabe_ito() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Body mass (g)")
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](dashboard_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){fig-alt='Boxplot of penguin body mass in grams by species. Gentoo is clearly the heaviest, Adelie and Chinstrap overlap around 3,700 g.' width=672}
:::
:::


### Column {.tabset}


::: {.cell title='Bill scatter'}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(penguins, aes(bill_len, bill_dep, color = species)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_okabe_ito() +
  labs(x = "Bill length (mm)", y = "Bill depth (mm)", color = NULL)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](dashboard_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){fig-alt='Scatter plot of bill depth versus bill length in millimeters, colored by species. The three species form separate clusters.' width=672}
:::
:::



::: {.cell title='Mean measurements'}

```{.r .cell-code}
penguins |>
  summarise(
    bill_len = mean(bill_len),
    bill_dep = mean(bill_dep),
    body_mass = mean(body_mass),
    .by = species
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 1)
```
